task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale+bias over a 128x128 bf16 array, comparing a per-lane Python loop (N single-lane VMEM accesses) against one vectorized statement over the full block.

metrics.name: num_vmem_ops
metrics.description: number of distinct VMEM read/write operations the kernel body issues for one block. Naive: N (one per lane column). Optimized: 1. Exact and verifiable from the code/trace alone, no profiler needed -- reported directly by each file's __main__ block.

metrics.name: achieved_tflops_pct_of_peak_bf16
metrics.description: achieved throughput as % of v5e peak bf16 TFLOPS (197.0), same convention as 01_mxu_feed. As with 02_vmem_tile_layout, this cell is not compute-bound, so num_vmem_ops is the more direct signal -- this metric is secondary/confirmatory.
